name: Romance
description: Gentle affection and shared moments between two adults. Entries describe contact and support in neutral roles without fixing gender, appearance or setting.
entries: Two adults seated face-to-face on separate chairs, leaning toward each other with their hands joined between their knees.
One adult smoothing the other's collar while both stand facing each other at a comfortable distance.
Two adults seated together, one offering a flower while the other reaches to accept its stem.
One adult placing a scarf around the other's shoulders while standing beside them.
Two adults standing close, one gently brushing a loose strand of hair away from the other's face.
Two adults seated on a broad step, leaning shoulder to shoulder with their feet on the step below.
One adult resting a hand against the other's cheek while both turn their faces toward each other.
Two adults standing on opposite sides of a doorway, each resting a hand on the frame and leaning toward the opening.
Two adults leaning against a railing side by side, their hands resting together on its top edge.
One adult holding an open locket between them while the other leans closer to look at its contents.

Slow dance: two people facing each other at close range, one hand of each joined at shoulder height and their free hands resting at the other's upper back or shoulder, both supporting their own weight.
One person leaning forward to kiss the other person's forehead while the other tilts their head slightly down, both standing with their feet planted.
Two people walking side by side with their inner hands joined loosely between them, leaving space for both to step forward.
Two people seated side by side with shoulders touching, one resting their head against the other's shoulder while both remain supported by the seat.
Two people facing each other in an embrace, their arms around each other's upper backs and their heads turned slightly aside.
One person standing in front of the other and fastening a necklace at the back of their neck, the other holding their hair clear with one hand.
Two people seated across a small table, one resting an open hand on the surface while the other lays their hand gently over it.
Two people reclining side by side with their heads on separate cushions, turned toward each other and holding hands in the space between them.
One person seated while the other kneels beside them to offer a small wrapped gift, both looking toward the gift between them.
Two people standing side by side beneath a shared umbrella, one holding its handle between them while the other rests a hand on the holder's forearm.
